5. **Pullback:** 23.7% from ATH — largest discount of all three.

**Recommendation:** TSLA is bouncing from a deep pullback with the 200-MA as the next resistance. If holding shares, selling covered calls near $395–$400 (200-MA resistance) is the top strategy — RSI 62.2 supports selling into this bounce, and TSLA's high absolute IV compensates for the borderline IV rank.
